product_one_liner.value: Incorta provides enterprise data and AI teams with a governed platform that connects live operational data to analytics, AI agents, applications, and workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: Incorta describes its platform as connecting live operational data to analytics, agents, applications, and workflows; its privacy policy identifies enterprise users, and its demo page addresses data and AI teams. Sources: https://www.incorta.com/, https://www.incorta.com/legal-pages/global-privacy-policy and https://www.incorta.com/demo

pricing_page.notes: Public Incorta marketplace listings publish named plans and prices. This positive answer refers to those product pricing pages, not a standalone pricing page on incorta.com. Sources: https://marketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/apps/incorta.incorta_direct_data_platform?tab=PlansAndPrice and https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-4vnhp7q2eyppg

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Incorta's customer logo section explicitly names Starbucks and Comcast among the data and AI teams that trust it. Source: https://www.incorta.com/demo | named_customers.0: Starbucks appears in Incorta's customer logo section. | named_customers.1: Comcast appears in Incorta's customer logo section.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 334 employees, which falls within 201-500. Profile counts may differ from payroll headcount. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/incorta

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The contact page labels its Foster City address as Main Headquarters. This is preferred over older references to San Mateo. Source: https://www.incorta.com/contact | hq_country: The company profile explicitly identifies the country as United States. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/incorta

founded_year.notes: The company profile explicitly lists 2013, consistent with the origins described on its About page. An older funding announcement instead references 2014, so confidence is reduced. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/incorta and https://www.incorta.com/about-us

eng_blog.notes: Two Engineering@Incorta posts explain implementation: an in-memory join algorithm and OpenCopilot's agent architecture. The first author is identified as a senior software architect; the publication describes itself as a technical blog from Incorta engineers. Sources: https://medium.com/engineering-incorta/incorta-bringing-agility-to-the-star-schema-world-b0447f13a127 and https://medium.com/engineering-incorta/comparing-opencopilot-to-langchains-plan-and-execute-agent-479cf8de88db

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal provides current and previous release documentation plus separate release-support-policy and release-model resources. Source: https://docs.incorta.com/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers index lists Solution Engineer, Principle Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, and Account Executive. None has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science term in its title; LLM responsibilities within a software-engineer description do not qualify under the requested rule. Source: https://jobs.lever.co/incorta

model_provider.notes: The homepage names Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI. A product engineering job posting additionally describes the Incorta AI Gateway routing calls to models such as Claude. Sources: https://www.incorta.com/ and https://jobs.lever.co/incorta/dc034adb-5dab-48cc-9c75-3433ddf5b2d6

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page offers Incorta's SOC 2 Type II report and names GDPR compliance. GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a formal certification. Source: http://incorta.com/platform/security | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly offers Incorta's SOC 2 Type II report. | compliance_certs.1: The security page names GDPR compliance; this is not a formal certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest completed equity-round record and the company announcement both identify Series D, although their dates conflict. Sources: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/62315-56 and https://www.incorta.com/press-releases/incorta-raises-120m-in-series-d-funding-amid-soaring-global-demand-for-unified-data-analytics | funding_date: The latest-round date could not be resolved reliably: PitchBook reports April 24, 2025, whereas Incorta's announcement and CB Insights identify June 23, 2021. The field is therefore unknown rather than selecting one conflicting date. Sources: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/62315-56, https://www.incorta.com/press-releases/incorta-raises-120m-in-series-d-funding-amid-soaring-global-demand-for-unified-data-analytics and https://www.cbinsights.com/company/incorta/financials | funding_amount_usd: The latest completed Series D record lists $120 million, and Incorta's Series D announcement confirms that amount. The sources disagree on the round date, so confidence in the latest-round identification is reduced. Sources: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/62315-56 and https://www.incorta.com/press-releases/incorta-raises-120m-in-series-d-funding-amid-soaring-global-demand-for-unified-data-analytics

raised_18mo.notes: Both reported latest-round dates—April 2025 in PitchBook and June 2021 in the company announcement—precede the May 2025 start of the requested 18-month window. No later round was established. Sources: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/62315-56 and https://www.incorta.com/press-releases/incorta-raises-120m-in-series-d-funding-amid-soaring-global-demand-for-unified-data-analytics

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive opening has an application link and is also listed on the careers index. Sources: https://jobs.lever.co/incorta/8a6bbe3c-187c-40bc-976c-a53caec34a73 and https://jobs.lever.co/incorta

launched_6mo.notes: The September 30, 2026 announcement introduces Analyst Studio's governed data-transformation capabilities within Incorta Intelligence, a major feature launch inside the six-month window. Source: https://www.incorta.com/press-releases/incorta-adds-governed-data-transformation-for-agentic-workflows-with-incorta-intelligence

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Omar Hajsaleh's profile lists his Incorta Vice President of Sales EMEA employment beginning in December 2025, within the requested 12-month window. Source: https://linkedin.com/in/omar-hajsaleh

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: An Incorta SDR posting explicitly instructs employees to manage prospect interactions in Salesforce and Outreach, providing an operational-use signal rather than merely naming integrations. Source: https://jobs.lever.co/incorta/296a367c-e2b9-4d27-976b-805b5e8ecd31?lever-source%5B%5D=careers.sorensoncap.com | crm_stack_signal.0: The SDR posting explicitly requires managing prospect interactions in Salesforce. | crm_stack_signal.1: The same SDR posting explicitly requires managing prospect interactions in Outreach.
